messages:
maya: hey folks :wave: I’m a new PM on the design-integrations squad. quick q — I can’t open the team Figma files. also where do you keep the product roadmap docs and our research process? first week checklist things.

devon: welcome maya!! :tada: you should be in the "designers-redwood" SSO group but sometimes provisioning misses people. pinging @samir (designops) to confirm.

samir: hey maya, welcome :smile: I see you’re not in the group yet. i’ll kick off an Okta add — should be done in ~10-30m. for now, if you need immediate access, request a guest link on the file and tag me.

maya: thanks samir — that’d be awesome. is there a formal request flow or just ask you directly?

samir: either works. long-term: use the IT ticket workflow (Helpdesk > Access > Design tools). short-term: DM me or post here and i’ll escalate.

lisa: re: roadmap docs — product keeps the canonical roadmap in Notion under /Product > Roadmap (private to product org). i’ll add you to the product workspace after you accept the invite. we also keep quarterly plans in the shared Google Drive (Prod-Roadmaps).

devon: research process stuff is in the Design Playbook (Notion) — recruiting participants, consent templates, and the research checklist. also we have a lightweight repo of recent session notes: Notion > Research > Session Log.

maya: perfect. can you drop the Notion links here? also any must-read onboarding docs for designers/PMs?

lisa: sure. two quick reads: "Design Playbook — Starter" and "Product Onboarding — PM + Designer checklist". i’ll DM the links (internal). Must-reads: handoff template, prototyping standards, and the accessibility checklist.

samir: logging the Okta ticket now. ticket#: HD-4521. snippet of the change i filed:

```
Action: Add user maya@redwood.com to group designers-redwood
Requester: samir
Reason: New hire — Product/Design
Notes: Grant Figma org license + access to team files: "Design System", "Integrations - Drafts"
```

samir: okta says provisioning will finish in ~15m. once you can access Figma, open the file and request edit access on any team files you need.

devon: quick FYI — we have a 1:1 at 3pm today for onboarding sync. also weekly design critique on Thursdays @ 11am — highly recommend.

maya: seeing Figma now :yay: can open "Integrations - Drafts". thanks everyone!! one more: where do I find past research participant lists and consent forms?

lisa: consent forms and participant templates are in the Research Playbook (Notion). i’ll drop the template in your DMs and add you to the Research workspace.

onboarding-bot: Welcome maya! Your onboarding checklist has been updated: Figma access (done), Product workspace invite (pending), Research workspace invite (pending), 1:1 scheduled. If anything else, reply here.

maya: awesome — this was super helpful. will read the playbook and ping if anything blocks. see you at 3pm! :rocket:
